html: I have been following the Second Renaissance for a long while now, but I have a question, what happens to corporations? I recall that you wrote somewhere that Google and Amazon were broken up and/or nationalised, but it has been a while so I do not recall it that well. Did this happen to all major corporations? There must be some big ones still around<ac_metadata title="Overall fate of corporations"> </ac_metadata>
